description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T) with Arrhenius R(T) and entropic heating
source: Fu et al. (2010) J. Electrochem. Soc.; Lee et al. (2011) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy; Chotard et al. (2014); Parker et al. (2017) Science

cell.name: Zinc-Air (primary/secondary)
cell.note: Primary: 1.65 V OCV; secondary (rechargeable): 1.35 V nominal

nominal_voltage.note: Nominal discharge voltage for secondary Zn-air

capacity_ref.note: Reference capacity at T_ref (normalize to 1 Ah cell)

voltage_max.note: Open-circuit voltage (Zn + 0.5 O2 -> ZnO, E^0 = 1.65 V)

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref; higher than Li-ion due to alkaline electrolyte and O2 transport

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial for Zn-air (SOC=1=full Zn electrode, SOC=0=fully discharged ZnO)
ocv_coefficients.source: Fu et al. (2010) J. Electrochem. Soc. 157(1), A50-A56
ocv_coefficients.note: Polynomial fit to Zn-air OCV: starts at 0.90 V (empty), rises to ~1.35 V plateau, reaches ~1.65 V OCV. Parker et al. 2017

E_a.note: Activation energy for Zn-air internal resistance (alkaline electrolyte KOH). Lee et al. (2011)

alpha_c.note: Capacity temperature coefficient (Zn-air slightly less T-sensitive than Li-ion)

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for Zn-air. Negative: discharge voltage drops slightly with T. Parker et al. 2017; Chotard 2014. Sign: dOCV/dT < 0 for Zn-air (entropy decreases on discharge)
